steps.label: No loss scaling needed at all

eyebrow: fp16 needs a scaler, bf16 doesn't
code:
scaler = GradScaler()
with torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.float16):
    loss = model(input_ids).loss
scaler.scale(loss).backward()
scaler.step(optimizer)
scaler.update()

# bf16: no scaler required
with torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16):
    loss = model(input_ids).loss
loss.backward()
optimizer.step()
caption: fp16 needs GradScaler to avoid underflow; bf16's exponent range makes it unnecessary.
